patch_local_audit.structural_argument: A rooted radius-2 induced patch contains every edge incident to the root and to every distance-1 node. Hence root and first-shell degrees are fully visible; distance-2 degrees are only partially visible. The number of patch tokens equals n_atoms, so the E2 multiset contains graph size, but mean pooling over tokens is invariant to token multiplicity and discards it.

readout_probe.note: Coarse local-patch key (root type, root degree, typed neighbour multiset, root ring closure, second-shell count); exploratory only.
